title: INC-9734: incident on the Data Lake Ingest
body:
Impact

The Data Lake Ingest incident described here is under
investigation at the time of writing. The hosting provider
Silverline Data was brought in by Data Services within the
first hour, and about 22 cases were tied to the event.

Timeline

Entries noted by Mei Chen up to 25 November 2025, in order:
- Error rates were compared against the regular baseline
- A disk on the storage node reported write failures
- Certificates on the edge proxies were renewed by hand

Status

Data Services lists the incident as under investigation.
Authored by Rohan Mehta, 26 August 2025, with a follow-up
check set for the 01:00-03:00 UTC window ahead of the
regular service meeting.
